name: A whole world in paper
art: The key transparent original asset is site/assets/atelier/paper-cutout.webp. Use its alpha silhouette and grounding relationship as evidence; create a comparably detailed original paper world if adapting the subject.

properties.label: Pop-up world below editorial title
properties.text: Fill the lower two thirds of a warm editorial page with an open pop-up book. Balance a large humane title above it against a three-item chapter list on the right.

properties.label: Humane serif and sans
properties.text: Pair humane serif and sans voices so the title belongs to the crafted editorial world.

properties.label: Detailed layered paper landscape
properties.text: Build a connected paper landscape with layered trees, a pavilion, bridge and winding stream. Give tree crowns layered cut edges, terrain stacked contours, and include turned page edges and small structural details.

properties.label: Cream and moss paper world
properties.text: Use warm cream #f1eadb, moss-green ink and many shades of cut paper.

properties.label: Grained hinged paper depth
properties.text: Keep visible paper grain and fold hinges that attach the world to the page. Use contact shadows between planes and coherent directional sunlight to reveal depth.

properties.label: Chapter crop selection
properties.text: Chapter choices reframe one richly rendered original image and update a caption while preserving the silhouette and book base in the complete view.

properties.label: Immediate paper crop changes
properties.text: The showcase is a raster cutout with CSS composition rather than live folding geometry. Reduced motion uses immediate crop changes.

properties.label: Paper structure inspection
properties.text: Inspect page thickness, folds, tree layers, bridge, stream and shadows at full size.

properties.label: Open-book mobile silhouette
properties.text: The mobile view must still read as an open book with a world inside rather than a cropped green mound. Flat clip-path trees cannot replace this authored detail.
